entry kan_matmul [m][n][p][g] (A: [m][n]f64) (B: [n][p]f64) : [m][p]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      reduce_comm (+, 0.0)
        (map (\k -> A[i,k] * B[k,j]) (iota n))
    ) (iota p)
  ) (iota m)
entry spectral_regulate [d] (state: [d][d]f64) (target: f64) : [d][d]f64 =
  let scale = target / f64.sqrt (f64.i64 d)
  in map (\row -> map (\val -> val * scale) row) state
entry tgn_update_kernel [bs][nf][md][td] (nodes: [bs][nf]f64) (memory: [bs][md]f64) (time: [bs][td]f64) (sp: f64) : [bs][md]f64 =
  let
    update_gates = map (\combined ->
      map (\c -> 1.0 / (1.0 + f64.exp (-c))) combined
    ) (zipWith2 (+)
      (map (\row -> reduce_comm (+, 0.0) (map (\n -> n / f64.i64 nf) row)) nodes)
      (map (\row -> reduce_comm (+, 0.0) (map (\t -> t / f64.i64 td) row)) time)
    )
    new_mem = zipWith3 (\ug mem cand ->
      zipWith (\u m c -> (1.0 - u) * m + u * c) ug mem cand
    ) update_gates memory
      (map (\ug -> map (\u -> f64.tanh u) ug) update_gates)
    masks = map (\bs_i -> map (\_ -> if f64.rand < sp then 1.0 else 0.0) (iota md)) (iota bs)
  in zipWith (\mem_row mask_row -> zipWith (*) mem_row mask_row) new_mem masks
entry kan_main (dim: i64) : [dim][dim]f64 =
  map (\i -> map (\j -> f64.i64 (i + j)) (iota dim)) (iota dim)

entry tgn_update_kernel [bs][nf][md][td] (nodes: [bs][nf]f64) (memory: [bs][md]f64) (time: [bs][td]f64) (sp: f64) (seed: i32) : [bs][md]f64 =
  let
    node_sum = map (\row -> map (\_ -> reduce_comm (+) 0.0 (map (\n -> n / f64.i64 nf) row)) (iota bs)) nodes
    time_sum = map (\row -> map (\_ -> reduce_comm (+) 0.0 (map (\t -> t / f64.i64 td) row)) (iota bs)) time
    combined = map2 (\ns ts -> map2 (+) ns ts) node_sum time_sum
    update_gates = map (\row ->
      map (\c -> 1.0 / (1.0 + f64.exp (-c))) row
    ) combined
    candidates = map (\ug -> map (\u -> f64.tanh u) ug) update_gates
    new_mem = map3 (\ug mem cand ->
      map3 (\u m c -> (1.0 - u) * m + u * c) ug mem cand
    ) update_gates memory candidates
    rng_state = u32.i32 seed
    hash_fn = \x -> ((x >> 16) ^ x) * 0x45d9f3b
    masks = map (\bs_i -> 
      map (\md_i -> 
        let val = hash_fn (hash_fn (rng_state + u32.i64 bs_i * 1000u32 + u32.i64 md_i))
        let normalized = f64.u32 val / f64.u32 u32.highest
        in if normalized < sp then 0.0 else 1.0
      ) (iota md)
    ) (iota bs)
  in map2 (\mem_row mask_row -> map2 (*) mem_row mask_row) new_mem masks
